endpoints.truth_yaml:
delete_workspaces_time_off_requests:
  operationId: deleteTimeOffRequest
  summary: Delete a time-off request
  x-verification-status: LIVE-VERIFIED
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521T233232Z-delete-workspaces-time-off-requests-happy-path.json
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521T233300Z-delete-workspaces-time-off-requests-missing-required.json
  x-notes: |
    Happy path confirmed live: create PENDING request then delete it returns
    {deleted:true, id, policyId, requestId}. The tool requires both policy_id
    and request_id. A non-existent/inaccessible request_id returns HTTP 403
    'Access Denied', NOT 404. This is source-of-truth only for our spec; ours
    is the only spec documenting this endpoint.
  x-truth-iter: iter15
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
    - name: requestId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Time-off request deleted
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: object
            properties:
              deleted:
                type: boolean
                example: true
              id:
                type: string
              policyId:
                type: string
              requestId:
                type: string
    '403':
      description: Access denied (request not found or not accessible)
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: object
            properties:
              message:
                type: string
                example: Access Denied
endpoints.notes: Our spec is the only source. Full happy-path lifecycle confirmed. Non-existent ID returns 403, not 404 — spec should document this. Policy ID is required alongside the request ID.

endpoints.truth_yaml:
delete_workspaces_user_groups_users:
  operationId: removeUserFromGroup
  summary: Remove a user from a user group
  x-verification-status: LIVE-OVERRIDE
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521T233300Z-delete-workspaces-user-groups-users-happy-path.json
  x-notes: |
    Full lifecycle confirmed live: create group → add user → remove user → delete group.
    Official spec names the path param 'userGroupId'; our spec uses 'groupId'.
    Both refer to the same path position; live API is indifferent to param naming.
    LIVE-OVERRIDE chosen because the actual param name discrepancy between
    specs constitutes a spec-level conflict that live resolved.
    Remove-user response shape is lean: {removed:true, groupId, userId}.
    Add-user response shape is the full updated group object.
  x-truth-iter: iter15
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
    - name: groupId
      in: path
      required: true
      description: User group ID (official spec calls this userGroupId; same path position)
      schema:
        type: string
    - name: userId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
  responses:
    '200':
      description: User removed from group
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: object
            properties:
              removed:
                type: boolean
                example: true
              groupId:
                type: string
              userId:
                type: string
endpoints.notes: Both specs agree on path. Official uses 'userGroupId', ours uses 'groupId' — live doesn't care, but ours is more consistent with the rest of the groups API. LIVE-OVERRIDE because the two specs name the param differently.

endpoints.truth_yaml:
delete_workspaces_invoices_items:
  operationId: deleteInvoiceItem
  summary: Delete an invoice item by line order
  x-verification-status: LIVE-VERIFIED
  x-evidence:
    - PROBE-LOG/20260521T233400Z-delete-workspaces-invoices-items-happy-path.json
  x-notes: |
    Full lifecycle confirmed live: add item to UNSENT invoice → delete by order index.
    The path parameter 'order' is a 1-based integer line position, NOT a MongoDB ID.
    Invoice items have no standalone ID field (id='' in list responses).
    item_type MUST match a workspace-configured invoice item type name exactly;
    passing an unconfigured type (e.g. 'Service') returns 404.
    The ADD endpoint returns the full invoice object, not just the new item.
    DELETE response: {deleted:true, invoiceId, itemId (string), itemIndex (string)}.
    Both specs agree on path and the 'order' parameter concept.
  x-truth-iter: iter15
  parameters:
    - name: workspaceId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
    - name: invoiceId
      in: path
      required: true
      schema:
        type: string
    - name: order
      in: path
      required: true
      description: 1-based line position of the invoice item (not a MongoDB ID)
      schema:
        type: integer
        minimum: 1
  responses:
    '200':
      description: Invoice item deleted
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: object
            properties:
              deleted:
                type: boolean
                example: true
              invoiceId:
                type: string
              itemId:
                type: string
                description: String representation of the order index
              itemIndex:
                type: string
                description: String representation of the order index
    '404':
      description: Invoice item type not found or item index out of range
endpoints.notes: Both specs agree on path. Live confirmed. Key finding: item_type must be workspace-configured, not arbitrary. Items have no MongoDB IDs — identified only by 1-based order index.
